rule: Page fills only from a stored first-party AI-page URL. The company's generic trust, privacy, or status page is not enough. No SafeBase, login-walled portals, or third-party directories. When unsure, leave the rule open. Do not invent processors, evals, incidents, companies, or URLs.
method: Conservative curated first-party list, checked by fetch (crawl.fetch, UA opentrust.center/1.0). A URL is filed only when HTTP 200 and the document is clearly an AI instrument on the company's own domain or an official docs/research/CDN subdomain they operate. Soft-404s, homepage bounces, Cloudflare/login walls, vendor hosts, and third-party org pages are rejected. Path guesses that returned 404 stay open.
